image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a handmade baby bib lying flat on a white textured surface (likely a blanket). The bib features a white central panel with subtle vertical pleats or texture, bordered by light blue ruffled lace trim. A diagonal sash of bright pink fabric with large white and smaller green polka dots crosses the front. The neck opening is curved and also trimmed with the blue lace. Yellow ribbon ties are visible at the top corners.
